name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.inner_eq_petersson
summary: Unfold the Petersson product and integrate the class function over the classes.

steps.claim: The Petersson product is the integral of conj(F)·F′; for the forms associated with algebraic forms it is a class integral (`Space.integral_mul_eq_classIntegral`, the conjugate of ofAlgForm being a form, `Space.star_ofAlgForm`).
Comparing with the class-sum inner product of φ, φ′ (Gram forms), the factors are the index of the level and #WeylIndex.
